question.text: Using CAPM, if Rf=7%, Rm=14%, beta=0.9, expected return is:

explanation.text: The Logic: E(R) = 7 + 0.9*(14-7) = 7 + 6.3 = 13.3%. The Trap: Other values come from arithmetic slips. Cross-Exam Context: CAPM calc across XV, X-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Check beta sensitivity; a 0.1 beta shift changes expected return meaningfully.
